## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List commands run and their results. Include the compiler and Linux environment
when changing build, packaging, or storage behavior. Explain any check not run.

## Storage impact

Describe changes to device selection, permissions, target checks, destructive
operations, cancellation, or verification. Write "None" when these do not change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and followed CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] My contributions are original or have compatible licensing and attribution.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md are updated when needed.
- [ ] I have run the relevant checks and reported their results above.
- [ ] The change preserves protected-device checks and destructive-operation confirmation.
- [ ] Automated tests use temporary regular files; no physical storage device was required.
- [ ] No generated packages, local dependencies, personal data, credentials, or private paths are included.
- [ ] Both author and committer use GitHub noreply identities; the complete HEAD history check passed.

Do not disclose a vulnerability in a public pull request. Follow SECURITY.md.
